turns.text: Product costs changed. What did that do to margin by subcategory?

csvChecks.ask: margin_by_subcategory.csv with columns subcategory,gm_fy2024_pct,gm_fy2025_pct,cost_effect_usd: every subcategory sold in FY2024 or FY2025, gross margin in % each year (blank if none sold), and cost_effect_usd = the sum over FY2025 lines of OrderQty × (standard cost in force on the order date − standard cost in force on the same date a year earlier), positive when costs rose
